taglineZh: 把业务字段整理成类型、必填、枚举与校验规则齐全的表单定义
taglineEn: Turn business fields into typed, validated form schemas
descZh: 把业务口述或纸质单据上的字段整理成可被程序消费的 Schema：字段类型、必填与默认值、字典枚举、主从表关系、编号规则和校验时机。做录入表单、编辑页或导入模板前先用它定结构。产出字段清单、校验规则和示例 JSON。
descEn: Consolidates business fields into machine-consumable schemas: types, required flags, defaults, enums, master-detail relations, numbering rules and validation timing. Use before building entry forms, edit pages or import templates. Outputs a field list, validation rules and sample JSON.
outputZh: 字段清单 + 校验规则 + 示例 JSON
outputEn: Field list + validation rules + sample JSON
demoCaptionZh: 采购单录入表单：必填、枚举与数值校验实时触发，右侧同步展示字段 Schema
demoCaptionEn: Purchase-order form with live required/enum/numeric validation beside its field schema

taglineZh: 规划列表、详情、编辑三件套与导航层级、审批流、权限矩阵
taglineEn: Plan list-detail-edit page trios, navigation and approval flows
descZh: 从零规划一个管理端，或重整现有后台混乱的页面关系。给出页面清单、导航结构、每页的字段与动作，覆盖列表页、详情页、编辑页三件套以及导入向导、审批流、权限矩阵。产出结构与约定文档，不含可运行代码。
descEn: Plans an admin console from scratch or untangles messy page relationships. Delivers page inventory, navigation structure, per-page fields and actions, covering the list-detail-edit trio plus import wizard, approval flow and permission matrix. Outputs structure and conventions, not runnable code.
outputZh: 页面清单 + 导航结构 + 每页字段与动作
outputEn: Page inventory + nav structure + per-page fields/actions
demoCaptionZh: 采购管理模块的信息架构图：点击节点查看该页的字段、动作与跳转关系
demoCaptionEn: IA diagram of a purchasing module; click nodes to see fields, actions and links

taglineZh: 固定侧栏加 KPI 网格与图表的单页数据概览看板
taglineEn: Single-page overview with fixed sidebar, KPIs and charts
descZh: 做一个能看数的单页概览：固定左侧栏、顶栏、3-5 张 KPI 卡、一到两张主图和最近动态列表。只需要数据概览、不需要增删改查时用它。产出单页 HTML 模板。
descEn: Builds a single-page data overview: fixed sidebar, top bar, 3-5 KPI cards, one or two charts and a recent-activity list. Use when you only need to view metrics, not CRUD. Outputs a single-page HTML template.
outputZh: 单页 HTML 看板模板
demoCaptionZh: 运营概览看板：侧栏导航、四张 KPI 卡与可切换周期的营收趋势图，示例数据
demoCaptionEn: Ops overview: sidebar nav, four KPI cards and a revenue chart with period toggle (sample data)

taglineZh: ERP/CRM 管理端的页面配方：列表详情编辑、导入与权限
taglineEn: Page recipes for ERP/CRM consoles: list, detail, edit, import
descZh: 把业务做成能干活的管理端。提供八个页面配方（列表、详情、编辑、导入向导、权限矩阵、审批流、字典编号、主从表）和十二条硬规矩，如服务端分页、筛选进 URL、金额不用浮点。产出 React + shadcn/ui 的可落地页面结构与字段定义。
descEn: Turns business requirements into working admin consoles. Provides eight page recipes (list, detail, edit, import wizard, permission matrix, approval flow, dictionaries, master-detail) and twelve hard rules like server-side pagination and integer-cents money. Outputs implementable React + shadcn/ui page structures and field definitions.
outputZh: React + shadcn/ui 页面结构与字段定义
outputEn: React + shadcn/ui page structures and field definitions
demoCaptionZh: 客户订单列表页：搜索、状态筛选、服务端式分页真实可用，点行打开详情抽屉
demoCaptionEn: Order list with working search, status filter and pagination; rows open a detail drawer

taglineZh: 用 iga CLI 把前端与全栈项目部署上线并拿到预览链接
taglineEn: Deploy frontend and full-stack projects via the iga CLI
descZh: 把 Next.js、Vite 等前端或带 API 的全栈项目部署到 IGA Pages。覆盖登录鉴权（本地浏览器 / 远端 AK-SK）、项目链接、本地 dev、构建与部署，支持 Git 与上传两种方式，处理 serverless 函数路由。产出可用的部署命令流程与预览链接。
descEn: Deploys Next.js/Vite frontends or full-stack projects with APIs to IGA Pages. Covers auth (browser locally, AK/SK headless), project linking, local dev, build and deploy via Git or upload, plus serverless function routes. Outputs a working deploy command flow and preview URL.
outputZh: 部署命令流程 + 预览链接
demoCaptionZh: 部署控制台示意：点击运行部署，逐步执行登录、构建、上传并生成预览链接（模拟）
demoCaptionEn: Deploy console mock: run a simulated login-build-upload pipeline that yields a preview URL

taglineZh: Notion 风团队动态总览：KPI、七日趋势与实时活动流
taglineEn: Notion-style team overview: KPIs, 7-day trends, activity feed
descZh: 展示团队正在做什么、进展如何。含 KPI 卡、七日 sparkline 趋势、带头像的活动流和斑马纹任务表，Notion 式 callout 与状态 pill 配色，没有数据源时用种子数据兜底。产出单页 HTML 模板。
descEn: Shows what the team is doing and how work is progressing. Includes KPI cards, 7-day sparklines, an avatar activity feed and a zebra-striped task table with Notion-style callouts and status pills; seeded data works without a live source. Outputs a single-page HTML template.
outputZh: 单页 HTML 实时看板模板
demoCaptionZh: 产品团队周看板：KPI 数字轻微跳动、七日趋势线与滚动更新的活动流，种子数据
demoCaptionEn: Product team weekly board: gently ticking KPIs, 7-day sparklines and a live-updating feed (seeded)

taglineZh: 像素级 iPhone 15 Pro 边框内的一屏界面
taglineEn: One app screen inside a pixel-accurate iPhone 15 Pro frame
descZh: 做一张能放进官网或应用商店页的手机界面效果图：状态栏、灵动岛、安全区留白、清晰的内容原型（feed/列表/详情/表单）和底部标签栏，全部装在像素级 iPhone 15 Pro 设备边框里。产出单页 HTML 模板。
descEn: Produces a store-ready phone screenshot: status bar, dynamic island, safe-area spacing, one clear content archetype (feed/list/detail/form) and a bottom tab bar, all inside a pixel-accurate iPhone 15 Pro frame. Outputs a single-page HTML template.
outputZh: 单页 HTML 设备展示模板
demoCaptionZh: 记账 App 一屏：灵动岛与安全区齐备，底部四个标签可切换账单、统计与我的
demoCaptionEn: Budget app screen with dynamic island and safe areas; four tabs switch bills, stats and profile

taglineZh: iOS/安卓/鸿蒙/小程序/H5 五套尺寸规范与单位换算
taglineEn: Sizing specs and unit conversion across five mobile platforms
descZh: 把五套移动端尺寸规范落到代码：主稿宽度、pt/dp/vp/rpx/px 单位换算、触控热区与字号下限、状态栏与底部安全区、切图倍率，并覆盖平板与折叠屏等扩展形态。写移动端样式、做设计稿标注或 UI 走查时用。产出带官方依据的数值表与修正后的代码。
descEn: Applies five platforms' sizing rules to code: artboard widths, pt/dp/vp/rpx/px conversion, touch-target and font minimums, status bars and bottom safe areas, export scales, plus tablet and foldable forms. Use for mobile styling, spec annotation or UI audits. Outputs sourced value tables and corrected code.
outputZh: 跨平台数值对照表 + 修正代码
demoCaptionZh: 五端规范对照板：主稿宽度、触控与字号下限数值表，附实时单位换算器
demoCaptionEn: Five-platform spec board: artboard, touch and font minimums plus a live unit converter

taglineZh: 启动页、价值主张页、登录页三屏并排的新用户引导
taglineEn: Splash, value-prop and sign-in screens shown side by side
descZh: 展示新用户第一次打开应用看到的三个关键屏：启动页（logo 与口号）、价值主张页（插图、一句话与圆点指示器）、登录页（邮箱、Apple、Google 与主按钮）。要呈现完整首启体验时用。产出单页 HTML 模板。
descEn: Shows the three screens a new user first sees: splash (logo and tagline), value proposition (illustration, one line, dot indicators) and sign-in (email, Apple, Google, primary CTA). Use to present the full first-launch experience. Outputs a single-page HTML template.
outputZh: 单页 HTML 三屏引导模板
demoCaptionZh: 习惯打卡 App 引导三屏：圆点可切换价值页，登录页输入邮箱后主按钮点亮
demoCaptionEn: Habit app onboarding: dots switch value screens; the sign-in CTA activates on valid email

taglineZh: KPI 卡、真渲染图表、色阶表格与洞察一体的报告页
taglineEn: Report page with KPIs, rendered charts, scaled tables and insights
descZh: 把结构化数据渲染成可交付的单文件 HTML 数据汇报：头部口径、3–5 张 KPI 卡、至少两张真渲染图表、带色阶标注的数据表、基于真实数据的洞察块与方法论折叠区。数字必须来自用户输入；图表容器给固定高度；交付前核对文档声称的图表库是否随包提供，缺库降级为内联 SVG。
descEn: Turns structured data into a deliverable single-file report: header with scope and source, 3–5 KPI cards, at least two rendered charts, a color-scaled table, evidence-based insights and a folded methodology section. Numbers come only from input; chart containers get fixed heights; claimed chart libraries are verified before delivery, falling back to inline SVG.
